goal: Prevent false internal bug assertions when mining RPCs run during node shutdown
Return a standard shutdown error to mining RPC clients instead of an assertion failure

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because benign shutdown during mining calls triggers false internal bug assertions
Affects miners using getblocktemplate or longpolling while stopping the node

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because callers receive misleading assertion failures rather than standard shutdown error codes
Ensures predictable error handling for RPC clients when the node shuts down
